title: Downloads of Government Mobile Applications
description: Download statistics for official government mobile applications across different platforms (Android, Huawei, iOS), including platform-specific counts.

fields.name: app_id
fields.title: Application ID
fields.description: [Integer] Unique identifier for each government mobile application; this is intended as a lookup reference only, and has no external meaning.

fields.name: app_name
fields.title: Application Name
fields.description: [String] The official name of the government mobile application.

fields.name: android
fields.title: Android
fields.description: [Integer] Total number of downloads from Google Play Store used on Android devices.

fields.name: huawei
fields.title: Huawei
fields.description: [Integer] Total number of downloads from Huawei AppGallery.

fields.name: ios
fields.title: iOS
fields.description: [Integer] Total number of downloads from Apple App Store used on iOS devices.

methodology: Under the standards specified by the National Digital Department (JDN), all government mobile applications must be registered with the Malaysia Government Mobile Applications Gallery (GAMMA). This dataset represents download statistics collected from app stores and platform analytics for registered government applications.
caveat: The data represents download statistics for applications published via GAMMA only. As a result, the number of applications with tracked download statistics is smaller than the [total number of applications](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/government_apps).
